title: ATS Jobs — Seven Public Career Systems

companies.title: Companies
companies.description: Up to 50 ATS board URLs, slugs, or objects with url/slug, ats, website, name, and region. An own website is fetched once to detect embedded ATS URLs.

postedAfter.title: postedAfter
postedAfter.description: Exclusive YYYY-MM-DD date; jobs with unknown dates are excluded.

remoteOnly.title: Remote only
remoteOnly.description: Include only explicitly remote jobs. Unknown remote status is excluded.

maxJobsPerCompany.title: maxJobsPerCompany
maxJobsPerCompany.description: Runtime default 1000. Limits can make results incomplete; see OUTPUT.

maxItems.title: maxItems
maxItems.description: Runtime default 10000. Limits can make results incomplete; see OUTPUT.

pageSize.title: pageSize
pageSize.description: Runtime default 100. Limits can make results incomplete; see OUTPUT.

maxPages.title: maxPages
maxPages.description: Runtime default 100. Limits can make results incomplete; see OUTPUT.

requestDelaySeconds.title: Request interval
requestDelaySeconds.description: Minimum seconds per origin; runtime default 1.2.
